mapper.sql:
SELECT CONCAT('MSG-', M.MSG_SN) AS LOG_KEY, M.REG_DT AS SEND_DT, COALESCE(R.SCHL_NM, '-') AS SCHL_NM, 'TEACHER_TO_STUDENT' AS TARGET_CD, '선생님 -> 학생' AS TARGET_NM, M.MSG_CN AS CONTENT, CASE WHEN M.STDNT_CNT > 0 AND M.STDNT_CNT = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EDU_TCHR_MSG_RCPT MR WHERE MR.MSG_SN = M.MSG_SN AND MR.DEL_DT IS NULL ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SUCCESS_YN, CASE WHEN M.STDNT_CNT > 0 AND M.STDNT_CNT = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EDU_TCHR_MSG_RCPT MR WHERE MR.MSG_SN = M.MSG_SN AND MR.DEL_DT IS NULL ) THEN '성공' ELSE '실패' END AS SUCCESS_NM FROM EDU_TCHR_MSG M LEFT JOIN EDU_RSVT_MST R ON R.RSVT_SN = M.RSVT_SN AND R.DEL_DT IS NULL WHERE M.DEL_DT IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT CONCAT('CALL-', C.CALL_SN) AS LOG_KEY, C.REG_DT AS SEND_DT, COALESCE(R.SCHL_NM, '-') AS SCHL_NM, 'STUDENT_TO_TEACHER' AS TARGET_CD, '학생 -> 선생님' AS TARGET_NM, C.CALL_CN AS CONTENT, CASE WHEN C.CALL_STTS_CD IN ('WAIT', 'READ') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SUCCESS_YN, CASE WHEN C.CALL_STTS_CD IN ('WAIT', 'READ') THEN '성공' ELSE '실패' END AS SUCCESS_NM FROM EDU_TCHR_CALL C LEFT JOIN EDU_RSVT_MST R ON R.RSVT_SN = C.RSVT_SN AND R.DEL_DT IS NULL WHERE C.DEL_DT IS NULL

choose.otherwise: AND (L.SCHL_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR L.CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
